name: PIZA E VINO
address: 36 George Rex Dr, The Heads, Knysna, 6571, South Africa
description_short: Italian pizzeria at The Heads serving wood-fired pizzas and pasta with stunning Knysna Lagoon views.
description_long:
Perched at The Heads with sweeping views across the Knysna Lagoon, PIZA E VINO brings authentic Italian flavours to one of the Garden Route's most scenic spots. The wood-fired pizzas are the main draw here, with thin, crispy bases and generous toppings that keep locals and visitors coming back. The pasta dishes hold their own too, and the relaxed atmosphere makes it equally good for a casual family lunch or an evening out with friends.

The location is unbeatable — you're dining with the lagoon stretched out before you and the Heads framing the view. It's the kind of place where you linger over a glass of wine as the sun sets, watching boats drift past. The outdoor seating fills up quickly on good weather days, so arriving early or booking ahead is wise. Service is friendly and unpretentious, matching the laid-back vibe of this Knysna favourite.
